payload.name: pc-check-timeout-ms
payload.description: Pure-logic validator that inspects a raw candidate timeout_ms and returns whether it is a valid integer in 0..7500 inclusive. Reads the raw value with inputs.get so a missing key is a valid outcome, never raises, and never coerces. Returns {valid, timeout_ms} where timeout_ms is the original integer when valid or null otherwise. No host calls, imports or I/O.
